name: Vanessa Cromwell
original_name: ヴァネッサ＝クロムウェル
source: The Queen's most trusted confidant and the commander of the Royal Guards. Nicknamed the 'Golden Goddess of War', Vanessa is the kingdom's most skilled wielder of lances and her fame is wide reaching. Abandoning her feminine side, Vanessa has chose to give her everything to martial affairs. Along with the Queen, Vanessa is a descendant from the heroes who sealed Astaroth 200 years ago.
